summary: Implements the Pydantic AI provider integration, offering model registries, execution logic, routing, prompt building, agent creation, tool mapping, and result/error mapping for AI operations.
responsibilities: Implements the Pydantic AI provider integration for AI model execution, routing, and registry management.
Handles prompt building, agent creation, tool mapping, and stream processing for Pydantic AI models.
Maps Pydantic AI errors, results, and finish reasons to standard formats.
relationships: Pydantic AI provider interacts with Google API configuration to create models, embeddings, and model registries.
design_decisions: Uses PydanticAI library for agent creation, model execution, and streaming responses.
Provides configuration and registry mechanisms for Google API access and model routing.
